effectivePresenceBasis: The static host registration, published channel, bridge, instance lane, field fold and optics read form the full chain. Every member has materialization1; the field interpolates ones, independently of coverage. No scene retargets presence.
limitations: Regular variant and presence1 are source-derived, NOT report-observed GPU values. Actual policy, sampling, renderer and root-active candidate pose are report-observed. Intermediate presence is unmeasured; native survival is not established here.

sourceChain.claim: Registers every host variant regular without present override, publishes no materialization animation; reports actual policy and group sampling, with explicit candidate root-active pose.
registerHost seeds presence and presencePublished to 1 unless present false, writes the materialization property; frame publishes that driver and forwards readHostChannels to nodes.
readHostChannels reads and clamps the materialization property; the idle fallback is 1.
toSurfaceInput forwards node.channels to renderer surfaces without replacing materialization.
resolveSurfaces bounds materialization, and packInstances writes it at instance lane17.

WGSL_INSTANCE_STRUCT.mat is at byte offset68 (CPU lane17); eval_instance copies s.mat into m.mat. The union interpolates member mat, all 1 here, and writes acc.mat to the presence target. Empty-field presence is also 1.
Samples the presence target as mat and uses it for E3 replacement interpolation; at mat1 the replacement is the identified full-presence law.
Packs effective E3 strength conditioned on regular variant, nominal material policy and actual backdrop texture. Those actual policy/sampling axes are separately report-validated.
